options.content:
The time picker at the top right selects the window. A trade is included when its entry falls in that window. Coin defaults to LTC. The top line is the price: 15-minute candles through the one-time load, then one mid per minute from the hunter status file. The table under the totals is the entry, the exit, the profit or loss, and the controller that was saved at the time. Older rows say **not recorded yet** because controller snapshots start on 2026-10-12.

The best replay tries take-profit 1/2/3%, trail arm 0.8/1.5/2.5%, trail give-back 0.10/0.50/1.00%, and stop 10/20/40 ROE on the entries DMan Maker already took. It uses 15-minute high and low after the fill, and the minute mids after those candles run out. The label ending in **live** is the knob set saved now. Fees are left out. A trade that opens and closes inside one 15-minute candle keeps its recorded result. This screen does not invent new entries.

Pettibon keeps collecting on its own. The 20-second poll reads the local files and does not call Hyperliquid.
